geometry.coordinate_note: x runs across the local B.Cu trace; z runs outward from the upper face of the In6 ground reference toward the board bottom and air.

checks.title: Discrete potential equation residual below 1 µV at 1 V excitation
Halving spatial step changes fixed probe fields by less than 5%
Expanding remote grounded boundaries changes fixed probe fields by less than 2%
Capacitance per length changes by less than 5% on mesh refinement

boundary_conditions.scope: Open-space approximation by remote zero-potential boundaries; domain sensitivity retained.

limitations: Local grounded coplanar cross-section of one 1.1 mm straight section, extruded infinitely along its length. This is not a complete-board E-field solution.

Local B.Cu ground intervals are included. Other conductors, solder mask, package charge, real three-dimensional plane edges and via discontinuities are omitted. Native plane coverage does not prove its return-current distribution.
FR4_PROPOSAL epsilon 4.2 and 75 µm dielectric are saved design proposals, not fabricator-qualified frequency-dependent material data.
E(x,z,t)=E_1V(x,z)×Vsw(t) assumes an electroquasistatic, linear dielectric response. Magnetic induction, propagation, loss and radiation are excluded.
Sharp ideal copper corners create mesh-dependent edge peaks. Fixed probes and integrated energy are used for convergence; maximum field is not an insulation or EMC rating.
Only the fixed U7 ideal-PWM experiment supplies Vsw(t); the millisecond behavioral controls and hardware-evidence score do not change this model.
